newsitem.title: USA: Vermont lawmaker might back campaign finance bill.
newsitem.headline: Vermont lawmaker might back campaign finance bill.

text.p: A controversial campaign finance reform measure may now have the backing of the chairman of a key Vermont Senate committee.
But Vermont State Sen. William Doyle says he wants changes in the bill which has already passed the Vermont House. Doyle, R-Washington County, is chairman of the Government Operations Committee.
Democrats have been trying to move the bill out of committee.
Doyle wants to eliminate a clause in the House bill that would put a surcharge on income tax to fund some statewide political campaigns.
He wants to replace the tax with a voluntary check-off on tax filings, giving residents the option of helping with public campaign financing.
